svg.title: The Sheet Held
svg.desc: A direct crop of Alphonse Legros's Studies of Hands. One drawn hand holds a stylus above a smaller sheet within the composition. The whole detail remains an image from the collection photograph; no marks have been added.
svg.text: A hand, a stylus, another page inside the drawing.
The point meets a page that the drawing itself holds.
The second sheet stays small; the hand and stylus share its space.
ALPHONSE LEGROS / STUDIES OF HANDS / THE MET / 92.13.10
